paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy as represented by three different lines. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence", is linear, ranging from 0.91 to 0.98, with regular intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", also linear, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue line has circular markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 0.90 accuracy at x = 0.91 and remaining nearly constant around 0.99 accuracy through x = 0.98. The orange line, with diamond markers and dashed style, begins at about 0.65 accuracy at x = 0.91, peaking near 0.9 accuracy at x = 0.9, then declining to approximately 0.10 accuracy at x = 0.98. The green line is characterized by square markers and a dashed-dotted style, starting around 0.20 accuracy at x = 0.91, maintaining a low value until x = 0.93, and then increasing steadily to approximately 0.90 accuracy at x = 0.98. The green line and orange line intersect somewhere between x =0.95 and x=0.96. At each tick marker, there are error bars indicating variability or uncertainty. There is no legend attached to the plot to infer these lines.
